-- AAC Phase 1F
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links` (
  review_link_id STRING NOT NULL,
  article_id STRING NOT NULL,
  doctor_id STRING NOT NULL,
  secure_token_hash STRING NOT NULL,
  status STRING NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  first_opened_at TIMESTAMP,
  responded_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` (
  approval_id STRING NOT NULL,
  article_id STRING NOT NULL,
  approval_type STRING NOT NULL,
  status STRING NOT NULL,
  requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  deadline TIMESTAMP,
  responded_at TIMESTAMP,
  response STRING
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE article_for_review AS
SELECT
  a.article_id,
  a.doctor_id,
  a.campaign_id,
  a.doctor_review_deadline, a.current_version,
  d.doctor_name,
  d.credentials,
  p.practice_name,
  JSON_VALUE(v.content, '$.metadata.h1') AS article_title
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
  ON v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
  ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p
  ON p.practice_id = a.practice_id
WHERE a.status = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_PENDING'
  AND a.article_id = @article_id
  AND a.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.communications` cm
    WHERE cm.article_id = a.article_id
      AND cm.communication_type IN ('DOCTOR_REVIEW_REQUEST', 'DOCTOR_REVISED_DRAFT')
      AND cm.status = 'SENT'
      AND cm.sent_at >= v.created_at
  )
ORDER BY v.created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM article_for_review)
  AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');

CREATE TEMP TABLE new_link AS
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID() AS review_link_id,
  article_id,
  doctor_id,
  CONCAT(REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', ''), REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', '')) AS raw_token,
  COALESCE(doctor_review_deadline, TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 5 DAY)) AS expires_at
FROM article_for_review;

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links`
(review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, secure_token_hash, status, created_at, expires_at)
SELECT review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, TO_HEX(SHA256(raw_token)), 'READY', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), expires_at
FROM new_link;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING (
  SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS approval_id, article_id, 'DOCTOR_REVIEW' AS approval_type,
    'PENDING' AS status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS requested_at, expires_at AS deadline
  FROM new_link
) S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.approval_type = S.approval_type AND T.status = 'PENDING'
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET requested_at = S.requested_at, deadline = S.deadline
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (approval_id, article_id, approval_type, status, requested_at, deadline)
  VALUES (S.approval_id, S.article_id, S.approval_type, S.status, S.requested_at, S.deadline);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', article_id, 'doctor.review_requested', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'n8n', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(review_link_id, expires_at))
FROM new_link;

SELECT
  a.article_id, a.doctor_id, a.campaign_id, a.current_version, a.doctor_name, a.credentials, a.practice_name, a.article_title,
  n.review_link_id, n.expires_at,
  CONCAT('https://apex-content-interviewer.jdold.workers.dev/review/', n.raw_token) AS review_url,
  'READY' AS link_status
FROM article_for_review a
JOIN new_link n USING (article_id, doctor_id);

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1F - Create Review Link

Creates the review-link and approval tables when needed, invalidates earlier unused links, stores only a SHA-256 token hash, and returns the raw secure link once for delivery.

Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential before running.
